summary.answer:
The five largest non-test files in `src/` of honojs/hono are below. I cloned the repo with `--depth 1` into `/TMP

| Lines | File | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 2782 | `src/types.ts` | Central type definitions for Hono: `Env`, `Bindings`, `Variables`, `Handler`, `Next`, `Input`, `RouterRoute`, and related helper types used across the library. |
| 924 | `src/jsx/intrinsic-elements.ts` | The `IntrinsicElements` interface, which types the HTML tags and attributes allowed in Hono's JSX. The header says it is based on React's typings (MIT). |
| 879 | `src/jsx/dom/render.ts` | Hono's client-side JSX DOM renderer. It exports `render`, `build`, `buildNode`, and `renderNode`, which turn JSX nodes into real DOM and apply updates. |
| 798 | `src/context.ts` | The `Context` class passed to every handler (`c`). It holds the request, response helpers, `set`/`get` variables, and rendering. It also defines the `Renderer` and `ExecutionContext` types. |
| 726 | `src/adapter/aws-lambda/handler.ts` | The AWS Lambda adapter. `handle` converts API Gateway, ALB, and VPC Lattice events into a standard `Request` and converts the response back. `streamHandle` covers streamed responses. |

The next files by size are `src/hono-base.ts` (560 lines) and `src/request.ts` (520 lines).

If test files count too, the largest in `src/` are `src/types.test.ts` (4139), `src/hono.test.ts` (3906), and `src/jsx/dom/index.test.tsx` (3681). That puts `types.test.ts` and `hono.test.ts` at the top.

I read only the file headers, exports, and a few key function names for these descriptions, not each file in full. The method-level details of `Context` and the adapter behavior are from the names and structure, not from reading the bodies.

content.text:
The five largest non-test files in `src/` of honojs/hono are below. I cloned the repo with `--depth 1` into `/TMP

| Lines | File | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 2782 | `src/types.ts` | Central type definitions for Hono: `Env`, `Bindings`, `Variables`, `Handler`, `Next`, `Input`, `RouterRoute`, and related helper types used across the library. |
| 924 | `src/jsx/intrinsic-elements.ts` | The `IntrinsicElements` interface, which types the HTML tags and attributes allowed in Hono's JSX. The header says it is based on React's typings (MIT). |
| 879 | `src/jsx/dom/render.ts` | Hono's client-side JSX DOM renderer. It exports `render`, `build`, `buildNode`, and `renderNode`, which turn JSX nodes into real DOM and apply updates. |
| 798 | `src/context.ts` | The `Context` class passed to every handler (`c`). It holds the request, response helpers, `set`/`get` variables, and rendering. It also defines the `Renderer` and `ExecutionContext` types. |
| 726 | `src/adapter/aws-lambda/handler.ts` | The AWS Lambda adapter. `handle` converts API Gateway, ALB, and VPC Lattice events into a standard `Request` and converts the response back. `streamHandle` covers streamed responses. |

The next files by size are `src/hono-base.ts` (560 lines) and `src/request.ts` (520 lines).

If test files count too, the largest in `src/` are `src/types.test.ts` (4139), `src/hono.test.ts` (3906), and `src/jsx/dom/index.test.tsx` (3681). That puts `types.test.ts` and `hono.test.ts` at the top.

I read only the file headers, exports, and a few key function names for these descriptions, not each file in full. The method-level details of `Context` and the adapter behavior are from the names and structure, not from reading the bodies.
